verdict.rationale: Salv documents per-field name-matching configuration, with fuzzy matching and a user-set threshold for names and exact matching for identifiers. It also documents normalisation and transliteration across Cyrillic, Greek and Chinese (Traditional), and AI-Powered Insights explains the reasoning behind a name match so analysts can inspect it. Settings can be tested against your own history before going live. missing for 10: explicit alias-matching documentation, a clear description of how an analyst sees which alias or transliterated form triggered a hit, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
